record.bible_text: Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> to his anointed<WH04899>, to Cyrus<WH03566>, whose right hand<WH03225> I have holden<WH02388><WTH8689>, to subdue<WH07286><WTH8800> nations<WH01471> before<WH06440> him; and I will loose<WH06605><WTH8762> the loins<WH04975> of kings<WH04428>, to open<WH06605><WTH8800> before<WH06440> him the two leaved gates<WH01817>; and the gates<WH08179> shall not be shut<WH05462><WTH8735>; <RF>have...: or, strengthened<Rf>

Woe<WH01945> unto him that saith<WH0559><WTH8802> unto <FI>his<Fi> father<WH01>, What begettest<WH03205><WTH8686> thou? or to the woman<WH0802>, What hast thou brought forth<WH02342><WTH8799>?<CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, the Holy One<WH06918> of Israel<WH03478>, and his Maker<WH03335><WTH8802>, Ask<WH07592><WTH8798> me of things to come<WH0857><WTH8802> concerning my sons<WH01121>, and concerning the work<WH06467> of my hands<WH03027> command<WH06680><WTH8762> ye me.

Verily<WH0403> thou <FI>art<Fi> a God<WH0410> that hidest<WH05641><WTH8693> thyself, O God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, the Saviour<WH03467><WTH8688>.

They shall be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8804>, and also confounded<WH03637><WTH8738>, all of them: they shall go<WH01980><WTH8804> to confusion<WH03639> together<WH03162> <FI>that are<Fi> makers<WH02796> of idols<WH06736>.

<FI> But<Fi> Israel<WH03478> shall be saved<WH03467><WTH8738> in the LORD<WH03068> with an everlasting<WH05769> salvation<WH08668>: ye shall not be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> nor confounded<WH03637><WTH8735> world<WH05769> without end<WH05703>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> that created<WH01254><WTH8802> the heavens<WH08064>; God<WH0430> himself that formed<WH03335><WTH8802> the earth<WH0776> and made<WH06213><WTH8802> it; he hath established<WH03559><WTH8790> it, he created<WH01254><WTH8804> it not in vain<WH08414>, he formed<WH03335><WTH8804> it to be inhabited<WH03427><WTH8800>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>; and <FI>there is<Fi> none else.

I have not spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> in secret<WH05643>, in a dark<WH02822> place<WH04725> of the earth<WH0776>: I said<WH0559><WTH8804> not unto the seed<WH02233> of Jacob<WH03290>, Seek<WH01245><WTH8761> ye me in vain<WH08414>: I the LORD<WH03068> speak<WH01696><WTH8802> righteousness<WH06664>, I declare<WH05046><WTH8688> things that are right<WH04339>.<CM>

Assemble<WH06908><WTH8734> yourselves and come<WH0935><WTH8798>; draw near<WH05066><WTH8690> together<WH03162>, ye <FI>that are<Fi> escaped<WH06412> of the nations<WH01471>: they have no knowledge<WH03045><WTH8804> that set up<WH05375><WTH8802> the wood<WH06086> of their graven image<WH06459>, and pray<WH06419><WTH8693> unto a god<WH0410> <FI>that<Fi> cannot save<WH03467><WTH8686>.

Tell<WH05046><WTH8685> ye, and bring <FI>them<Fi> near<WH05066><WTH8685>; yea, let them take counsel<WH03289><WTH8735> together<WH03162>: who hath declared<WH08085><WTH8689> this from ancient time<WH06924>? <FI>who<Fi> hath told<WH05046><WTH8689> it from that time? <FI>have<Fi> not I the LORD<WH03068>? and <FI>there is<Fi> no God<WH0430> else beside<WH01107> me; a just<WH06662> God<WH0410> and a Saviour<WH03467><WTH8688>; <FI>there is<Fi> none<WH0369> beside<WH02108> me.
Look<WH06437><WTH8798> unto me, and be ye saved<WH03467><WTH8734>, all the ends<WH0657> of the earth<WH0776>: for I <FI>am<Fi> God<WH0410>, and <FI>there is<Fi> none else.

I have sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> by myself, the word<WH01697> is gone out<WH03318><WTH8804> of my mouth<WH06310> <FI>in<Fi> righteousness<WH06666>, and shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799>, That unto me every knee<WH01290> shall bow<WH03766><WTH8799>, every tongue<WH03956> shall swear<WH07650><WTH8735>.

Surely, shall <FI>one<Fi> say<WH0559><WTH8804>, in the LORD<WH03068> have I righteousness<WH06666> and strength<WH05797>: <FI>even<Fi> to him shall <FI>men<Fi> come<WH0935><WTH8799>; and all that are incensed<WH02734><WTH8737> against him shall be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799>. <RF>Surely...: or, Surely he shall say of me, In the LORD is all righteousness and strength<Rf> <RF>righteousness: Heb. righteousnesses<Rf>
